description: Synthetic labeled cases for demos and local regression only.

dashboard.title: Operations Control Tower
dashboard.description: Operational KPIs sourced from the daily warehouse load.

insight_card.title: Operations data freshness
insight_card.what_to_watch: Operational KPI trustworthiness and warehouse load freshness.
insight_card.why_watch: Decide whether the current operating numbers can be interpreted and raise a data-platform issue when they cannot.
watch_for: The warehouse load is stale beyond the daily operating window.
Operational KPIs are missing a trustworthy current value.
questions: Can the current operating KPIs be trusted?
Should Data Platform intervene before business metrics are interpreted?

delivery_methods.label: Data Platform
delivery_methods.instructions: Escalate when freshness makes operational metrics unsafe to interpret.

dashboard.title: Growth Funnel
dashboard.description: Acquisition and conversion performance by device.

insight_card.title: Checkout conversion regression
insight_card.what_to_watch: Checkout conversion and its device-specific supporting signals.
insight_card.why_watch: Find actionable conversion regressions quickly while avoiding alerts caused by ordinary traffic movement.
watch_for: The movement is concentrated in mobile.
Mobile checkout errors rise while traffic remains broadly stable.
questions: Is mobile the likely source of the conversion regression?
Is there enough evidence for Growth and Engineering to act?

delivery_methods.label: Growth
delivery_methods.instructions: Notify Growth when conversion, device concentration, related errors, and stable traffic support a growth-owned issue.

delivery_methods.label: Engineering On-call
delivery_methods.instructions: Notify Engineering when mobile checkout errors corroborate a conversion regression.

dashboard.title: Revenue Health
dashboard.description: Executive view of revenue quality and growth drivers.

insight_card.title: Revenue deterioration
insight_card.what_to_watch: Revenue quality together with enterprise churn, pipeline, and new-customer context.
insight_card.why_watch: Surface business-impacting deterioration with enough context for Revenue Operations to decide what to do next.
watch_for: Enterprise churn corroborates the revenue movement.
Pipeline and new-customer context do not explain away the signal.
questions: Is enterprise churn a plausible driver of the revenue decline?
Does this warrant a Revenue Operations response?

delivery_methods.label: Revenue Operations
delivery_methods.instructions: Notify Revenue Operations when revenue deterioration is corroborated by enterprise churn.

delivery_methods.label: Executive Escalation
delivery_methods.instructions: Escalate only when evidence indicates severe business impact beyond routine Revenue Operations response.

dashboard.title: Retail Weekly Pulse
dashboard.description: Retail sales dashboard with a strong holiday pattern.

insight_card.title: Retail sales pulse
insight_card.what_to_watch: Retail sales in the context of orders and the seasonality index.
insight_card.why_watch: Separate ordinary seasonal movement from a retail issue that merits action.
watch_for: Sales move outside normal seasonal behavior.
Orders and sales do not move together.
The seasonality index is outside its normal range.
questions: Is the sales decline explained by normal seasonality?
Is there enough evidence to notify Retail Operations?

delivery_methods.label: Retail Operations
delivery_methods.instructions: Notify Retail Operations only when the movement is outside normal seasonal behavior.
